products.longDescription:
Discover the perfect solution for high-resolution, full-color heat transfers with our A3 DTF Film Roll (F86SM1) – a top-tier choice for professionals and print businesses. Featuring 500 A3+ size DTF transfer film sheets, this roll delivers exceptional print quality, eco-friendly performance, and professional-grade durability, setting a new standard for the DTF printing industry.

Whether you're a startup custom apparel brand or a high-volume print shop, our A3 DTF heat transfer film is designed to produce vibrant, detailed, and wash-resistant transfers on a wide variety of fabrics, including cotton, polyester, blends, and more. specifications.compatibility: Works with all standard DTF inks and printers

howToUse: Print your design in mirror image using DTF ink on the coated side of the film
Apply adhesive powder evenly to the wet ink and shake off the excess
Cure the powder using a heat press or curing oven until it melts smoothly
Transfer the design onto your fabric using heat and pressure
Peel the film (hot or cold) and enjoy a crisp, vivid transfer
